name: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk
summary: PT Bukit Uluwatu Villa Tbk develops environmentally friendly hotels and resorts in Indonesia. The company operates through Hotel and Real Estate segments. It also provides accommodation services and real estate; trading food and beverage services; transportation; hotel management; and hotel guest rooms and restaurant services. In addition, it sells land or villas. The company was founded in 2000 and is based in Badung, Indonesia.
